findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browser_screenshot, browser_render, browser_pdf · Public sink: browser_screenshot, browser_render, browser_pdf · Destructive: browser_render.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: browser_screenshot, browser_render, browser_pdf · Public sink: browser_screenshot, browser_render, browser_pdf · Destructive: browser_render

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
